terms.definition: A practitioner (individual physician, nurse, practitioner) or facility (hospital, clinic, laboratory) rendering healthcare services to members.
An eligible beneficiary covered under a healthcare insurance policy or Medicaid/Medicare program.
A decision by a health plan or payer that a health service, treatment plan, prescription drug, or medical equipment is medically necessary.
A formal bill or request submitted by a provider to a payer requesting payment for healthcare services rendered to a member.
The legal obligation of third parties (e.g., private health insurance, casualty insurance) to pay all or part of the expenditures for medical assistance provided under a Medicaid plan.
